title: Diffusion-Guided Cooperative Policy Learning for Target Tracking Based on Underwater Mobile Agent Networks
abstract: arXiv:2603.29426v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) provides a promising solution for cooperative target tracking in networks of autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs). However, existing methods still face three major challenges: 1) policy non-stationarity caused by concurrent updates among multiple agents; 2) inefficient policy learning caused by the heterogeneous quality of experiences accumulated during exploration; and 3) policy drift between stochastic exploration and deterministic execution under dynamic underwater disturbances. To address these challenges, this paper develops a four-layer hierarchical MARL architecture comprising global training scheduling, multi-agent coordination, local policy generation, and real-time action execution. translated_title: 基于扩散引导的水下移动代理网络协同目标跟踪策略学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.29426v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：多智能体强化学习（MARL）为自主水下航行器（AUV）网络中的协同目标跟踪提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，现有方法仍面临三大挑战：1）多智能体并发更新导致的策略非平稳性；2）探索过程中积累的经验质量异质性导致的策略学习效率低下；以及3）动态水下扰动下随机探索与确定性执行之间的策略漂移。为解决这些挑战，本文开发了一种四层分层MARL架构，包括全局训练调度、多智能体协调、局部策略生成和实时动作执行。在此架构基础上，我们提出了一种监督扩散辅助MARL（SDA-MARL）算法，该算法包含三种紧密耦合的机制。首先，一种双决策策略集成了基于扩散的引导机制。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散引导的监督式多智能体强化学习算法，通过四层分层架构有效解决了水下目标跟踪中的策略非平稳性、经验异质性和策略漂移问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a supervised diffusion-aided multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm with a four-layer hierarchical architecture to address policy non-stationarity, heterogeneous experience, and policy drift in underwater target tracking.
